project.description: The project in which the instance belongs. If it is not provided, Terraform uses the provider default.
project.rationale: Non-secret project id for the Terraform resource; access is still determined by `members` and `role`, not by repeating the project id here.

instance.description: The name or relative resource id of the Bigtable instance to manage IAM for.
instance.rationale: Selects the instance the binding attaches to; it is a target reference, not a credential.

role.description: The role to apply. Only one `google_bigtable_instance_iam_binding` may exist per role on an instance. Custom roles use `[projects|organizations]/{parent-name}/roles/{role-name}`. See [Bigtable access control](https://cloud.google.com/bigtable/docs/access-control#roles).
role.rationale: Combined with `members`, this grants permissions on the instance; overly broad roles weaken least privilege.

members.description: Identities granted the privilege in `role`. Each entry can be one of: **allUsers**, **allAuthenticatedUsers**, **user:{email}**, **serviceAccount:{email}**, **group:{email}**, **domain:{domain}**.
members.rationale: Defines who receives the role; public principals broaden access beyond least privilege.

condition.description: Optional IAM condition limiting when this binding applies.
condition.rationale: Parent block for conditional IAM; impact depends on the nested `expression` and principals.

expression.description: CEL expression evaluated when the condition is enforced.
expression.rationale: Constrains when a binding is active; the expression text is policy logic, not a secret.

title.description: Short title for the IAM condition.
title.rationale: UI metadata for operators; not used in authorization decisions.

description.description: Optional longer description of the IAM condition.
description.rationale: Optional prose documentation; ignored by IAM enforcement engines.
